tei:div.tei:p: zhwa dmar thams cad mkhyen pa lnga pas mdzad pa'i bla ma rgyang 'bod bzhugs so// kye ma/ pha rje btsun bla ma rin po che// khyed sangs rgyas kun dang dbyer med pa'i// deng mos pa'i bu la thugs brtse bas// 'phral rgyal sras mchog gi tshul bzung nas// lar bsam zhing skye ba bzhes mdzad pa'i// dpal karma pa zhes yongs su grags// rje khyed kyi byin rlabs mi dman yang*// rgyud nyon mongs drag pos yongs bzung nas// las nag po'i spyod pa dar ba'i tshe// dus snyigs ma lnga bdo'i sems can rnams// 'og ngan song g.yang sa kho nar lhung*// pha thugs rjes zung zhig karma pa// las sngar byas rnams la don ma mchis// chos sngar byas rnams la chos brgyad 'dres// lam rnal ma sgrub pa gcig ma dran// da khyed rang min pa re sa med// pha thugs rjes= lar gshin rje'i skyes bu'i rgyab nas ded// dus lo zla zhag gi mdun nas bsu// 'phral rnam g.yengs bya bas bar nas brid// de ma tshor bslus shig byung nyan 'dug /pha thugs rjes= gzhon dbang po gsal tshe byis pa'i sems// lus dar la bab tshe brel bas g.yengs// da rgas shing 'khog par gyur pa'i tshe// chos gsha' ma dran kyang phyis nas song*// pha thugs rjes= rang sdod par 'dod kyang sdod dbang med// nor khyer bar 'dod kyang khyer mi gtub// grogs 'grogs par 'dod kyang rang gcig pu// sang 'jig rten pha rol 'gro bar nges// pha thugs rjes= tshe 'di yi bag chags 'phen pa'i mthus// lam bar do'i 'phrang la ci 'dra ang*// dpe mdong sum nyal ba'i rmi lam bzhin// lar rang dbang thob pa shin tu dka'// pha thugs rjes= spyir 'khor ba'i chos la snying po med// sgos mi rtag lus la snying po med// 'di nam mkhar shar ba'i 'ja' tshon 'dra// de bden par bzung yang yal nas 'gro// pha thugs rjes= yar sangs rgyas rnams la dad pa med// mar sems can rnams la snying rje chung*// gos ngur smrig gyon kyang gzugs brnyan tsam// skra spu gri bzhar yang don sgo chung*// pha thugs rjes=

chos thos pa mang yang gnad ma khrol// kha bshad pa tsha yang rgyud ma dul// gnas ri khrod 'grim kyang khyim la sred// mig lta stangs byas kyang nyams myong med// pha thugs rjes= mi gzhan gyi skyon mtshang chung ngu rig /rang khong nas rul ba ye ma tshor// mi gzhan gyi mgo bo bskor bskor nas// sdug rang gis nyos pa ma lags sam// pha thugs rjes= khong rgyal ba'i gsung rab ma lus kun// sems rgyud la e phan mi sems par// khe drag pa sgrub phyir thos bsam byas// de thar pa'i lam du e 'gro ang*// pha thugs rjes= khyod chos pa'i tshul gyis 'jig rten bsgrub// lar skye bo kun gyi mchod pa len// tshe yang yengs bya ba'i ngang du btang*// dbugs khrog ger 'gro dus ci 'dra ang*// pha thugs rjes= bdag de slad skyo ba gting nas skyes// yar sangs rgyas rnams la gsol ba 'debs// spyir snyigs ma'i dus kyi sems can dang*// sgos chos pa'i tshul can bdag sogs la// pha thugs rjes zung zhig karma pa// bu nga la re sa gzhan na med// bya bral gyi skyid sdug khyed rang shes// dbyings zag med bde chen pho brang nas// mgon khyed dang dbyer med ro gcig shog /ces dpal tsā ri tra'i rin chen phug tu zhwa dmar dkon mchog yan lag gis mdzad pa'o//
